subject: Follow-up: hosted API pricing & peak TPS validation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Munroe <alice.munroe@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + numbers we discussed (hosted API)

Hi Alice — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple of concrete asks so we can model pricing accurately on our side: 

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Primary use: product personalization + 1:1 support summarization for 3 customer-facing apps
- Expected traffic pattern: steady daytime usage with spiky peaks during campaign launches
- Data governance: must be SOC 2 compliant; PII redaction will be handled client-side

Numbers we need to confirm (can you reply inline?):
1) Expected monthly token volume (best estimate or range)
2) Average tokens per request (sample average or median)
3) Expected peak TPS (token-per-second or requests-per-second if easier)
4) Monthly budget range you’re planning for hosted inference
5) Target unit economics (target $ / 1M tokens) if you have a target

Attachments: I included a stub MAP (NovaCorp_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the sample prompts file you showed — please confirm any updates.

If you prefer, we can propose two pricing options once I have the numbers: a) standard hosted pay-as-you-go with volume tiers and b) a 30-day pilot with an included token bucket + a committed burst capacity for peak TPS.

Next steps: can you send the numbers above by end of week? We’ll produce a short pricing sheet and a pilot proposal to share with procurement.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Alice Munroe <alice.munroe@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + numbers we discussed (hosted API)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. I pulled numbers from our roadmap + infra team; these are estimates but should be close enough for pricing. Inline answers below.

1) Expected monthly token volume: ~150,000,000 tokens / month (we expect steady growth over Q1, could be 120M–200M depending on rollout cadence)
2) Average tokens per request: roughly 1,200 tokens (most are multi-turn summarizations, some long-form personalization enrichments)
3) Expected peak TPS: planning for sustained peaks up to 45 TPS (token TPS; bursts up to ~110 TPS for short windows during campaigns)
4) Monthly budget range: we have a budget range of $3,500–$5,500 / month for the hosted inference line item today (we can flex for a pilot if we see clear value)
5) Target unit economics: target sits around $30 / 1M tokens for the team — lower would be ideal, but that’s what procurement will push for

Compliance: SOC 2 is required — happy to review your SOC 2 report. We’ll add our security team to the thread if you can share that.

We’re interested in a 30–60 day pilot with an included token bucket and guaranteed peak throughput for launches. Procurement would need a simple SOW and a pilot pricing appendix.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Munroe
Head of Platform, NovaCorp
alice.munroe@novacorp.com

--
Note: procurement@novacorp.com included for contracting steps.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + numbers we discussed (hosted API)

Marissa — thanks for looping us in. A couple of quick technical clarifications we should confirm with NovaCorp before pricing pilot: 
- Is their 45 TPS peak measured in requests/sec or token/sec? Their note said token TPS but product team often reports requests TPS. That affects batch sizing and cost.
- For the burst windows (~110 TPS), what is the expected duration and frequency? Is it a 5–10 minute spike during launches or sustained for hours?
- Do they require an SLA on P50/P95 latency for the pilot? If they need guaranteed latency, that changes reservation sizing and cost.

If procurement wants a simple SOW we should include: included token bucket for the pilot, explicit reserved peak throughput (burst allowance), SOC 2 attestation, and a flat overage unit price. I’ll draft an engineering appendix once we have the TPS clarifications.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Munroe <alice.munroe@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + numbers we discussed (hosted API)

Alice — great, thanks for the details and the budget range. Confirming next steps from our side so procurement has what it needs: 

What we’ll produce for you (by EOD Wed):
- Pilot proposal (30-day) with: 100M included tokens, reserved peak throughput 50 TPS (token/sec), burst allowance up to 120 TPS for 10-minute windows, and SOC 2 attestation
- Pricing appendix that maps to your targets: base pilot fee + overage at $28 / 1M tokens (we can align closer to your $30 target on a longer commit)
- Simple SOW and DocuSign-ready contract for procurement to review

Questions / asks for you: 
- Please confirm whether NovaCorp’s "45 TPS" was token/sec or requests/sec (we assume token/sec in the proposal)
- Procurement: who is the procurement contact and billing entity for the PO?
- Security: please let us know where to send our SOC 2 report (email or secure link)

I’ve attached a draft pricing sheet (redwood_custom_pricing_4387.pdf) — this is a placeholder and we’ll update it after any clarifications. If this structure looks good, I’ll push the DocuSign link for signature and route the pilot activation to our edge team.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa
